name: core
description: Hooks only: Python auto-format on Write/Edit, cross-platform terminal notifications, and a per-prompt behavioral block (`prompt_inject.sh`, shared Claude + Codex). The block is fixed; two pointers are conditional — `.llmwiki/insight/` when a knowledge root resolves in cwd, and a one-line `[council]` delegation reminder when a second-model CLI (codex / agy) is on PATH (Claude-only). Work guidelines live in `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`.

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/auto-format-python.py"; fi
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/notify_osc.py" Claude "Task completed"; fi
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/notify_osc.py"; fi
